scope.failure_behavior: Unbound keys and unsupported source actions return distinct statuses without inventing gameplay effects.

implementation.effect_semantics: Functions return ordered typed intent records and never mutate SimGameWorld or invoke host services. For a yard-mode menu command, ordering is SetYardMode, SetMapPlane(0) when needed, then MapToYard when the yard window was closed.

differential.coverage: The original DOS key event pump emitted the same FD41/FD43-46/FD11-14/FD21 event codes expected by the native model for pause, all four speeds, four window commands, and yard mode. Key reader, Control state, diagnostic print, and event dispatcher are explicit deterministic callbacks.
